units.source_text: 随从人催促动身：“天色倘暗足了，这大雪中行路更困难呢。”

en.t: The attendants urged him to set out: “If it grows completely dark, traveling through this heavy snow will be even more difficult.”

units.source_text: 薰君只得准备回家。

en.t: Kaoru had no choice but to prepare to go home.

units.source_text: 他又对大女公子说：“我到处察看，觉得这山庄实在太孤寂了。

en.t: He also said to the elder young lady, “After looking all around, I feel this mountain villa is truly too lonely.

units.source_text: 我京中的邸宅，像山家一般清静，出入的人也极少。

en.t: My residence in the capital is as quiet as a mountain home, and very few people come and go there.

units.source_text: 小姐倘肯迁居，我实不胜欣幸。”

en.t: If you would be willing to move there, I would be more delighted than I can say.”

units.source_text: 侍女们偶然听到这话，都觉得能够这样真好极了，大家笑逐颜开。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting happened to hear this and all thought it would be wonderful if things could be arranged that way, their faces breaking into smiles.

units.source_text: 小女公子看见这模样，想道：“这太不成样子了！

en.t: Seeing them like this, the younger young lady thought, “This is really disgraceful!

units.source_text: 姐姐哪里会听他呢！”

en.t: How could my sister possibly listen to him!”

units.source_text: 侍女们拿出果物来招待薰君，陈设十分体面。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting brought out fruit to entertain Kaoru, and the arrangement was quite proper and elegant.

units.source_text: 又拿出美好的酒肴来犒赏随从人等。

en.t: They also brought out fine wine and food to reward the attendants and others.

units.source_text: 以前蒙薰君赏赐一件香气馥郁的便袍而闻名于人的那个值宿人，

en.t: The night watchman who had once become known because Kaoru had bestowed on him a richly fragrant informal robe,

units.source_text: 髭须满脸，面目可憎，令人看了感到不快。

en.t: had a face covered with whiskers and an unpleasant, hateful look that made people uneasy to see.

units.source_text: 薰君心念此人如何可供使唤呢，便唤他来前，

en.t: Kaoru wondered how such a man could be of any use, and called him forward.

units.source_text: 问道：“怎么样？亲王故世之后，你很伤心吧？”

en.t: He asked, “How have you been? You must have been very sad since the prince passed away.”

units.source_text: 那人愁眉苦脸地哭泣着答道：“正是呢。

en.t: The man answered with a sorrowful face, weeping, “Indeed I have.

units.source_text: 小人这孤苦无依之身，全靠亲王一人的荫庇，过了三十多年。

en.t: This lonely, helpless body of mine lived for more than thirty years entirely under the protection of the prince alone.

units.source_text: 如今即使流浪山野，亦无‘树下’可投靠了。”

en.t: Now, even if I wander through the mountains and fields, there is no longer any ‘shade beneath a tree’ where I can take refuge.”

units.source_text: 他的相貌变得更加丑陋。

en.t: His appearance had become even uglier.

units.source_text: 薰君叫他把八亲王生前供佛的房间打开，

en.t: Kaoru had him open the room where the Eighth Prince had made offerings to the Buddha while he was alive.

units.source_text: 走进去一看，但见到处灰尘堆积，只有佛前的装饰依旧鲜艳不衰。

en.t: When he went inside and looked around, he saw dust piled everywhere, while only the ornaments before the Buddha remained as bright as ever.

units.source_text: 八亲王诵经念佛时所坐的床已收拾起来，影迹不留了。

en.t: The couch on which the Eighth Prince had sat to recite sutras and chant the Buddha’s name had been put away, leaving no trace behind.

units.source_text: 他回想当年曾与亲王约定：自己如果出家，当以亲王为师。

en.t: He recalled the promise he had once made with the prince: if he himself were to renounce the world, he would take the prince as his teacher.

units.source_text: 便吟诗曰：

en.t: Then he recited a poem:
